response.original_title: Power Pro Lucha: Aniversario: A Crystal Clear Destiny
response.overview: “To right wrongs, and triumph over evil..!”  Join Power Pro Lucha as we celebrate our 1-year anniversary the only way we know how—with a fun-filled Lucha fiesta in The City of Brotherly Love!  The second of our two-night Aniversario events, “Aniversario: A Crystal Clear Destiny”, takes place Saturday, April 4, concluding The Prodigy Cup Tournament as we crown the new Prodigy Cup Champion!
